_help: Category order, titles and intros. Photos come from folders: images-src/pieces/<category id>/<sub-collection>/<photo>.jpg. Each sub-collection folder becomes one card; its name is the card title ("antique-premium" -> "Antique Premium"; a number prefix such as "1-antique" sets the order and is hidden).
